name: Tasks
notes: Tasks piles, filters, Asks, the Claude dialog, closing

features.feature: Tasks shows every open thread's open tasks in piles I owe, Owed to me, Waiting for others, Nobody named, with counts, and a folded "Others · N"

A task goes to its pile by owner (me → I owe, a blocked one stays marked), handed over by me (Owed to me), what mine waits on (Waiting, a card per person), no owner (Nobody named), else Others; a pair linked across threads shows once
Order: Due (overdue, then date, then quiet longest), Quiet longest, Thread
The Thread filter (with counts) and the Who does it filter (Anyone, Claude can do, By hand) narrow every pile
A pile shows 6 cards then "+ N" / Show fewer
A card shows its title, who (story, blocked by, owner · client, stops T00x), mode icon, thread, also in another thread, due (late in red) or "no date", "quiet N d"
A card opens the task's Details on the right while Tasks stays
Asks (right panel) lists, by person, what they owe late, due within 3 days or quiet 5 days and what my work waits on them for, with their next meeting this week
With no open thread Tasks offers Open Threads; with no task it says "No open tasks"

Send to Claude opens the Claude dialog: the task and its thread, one skill field (Just the task, or skills ranked by fit with "fits best", chosen at once when clearly first; × back to Just the task), a note, Work on it, Yolo (from Today only), Cancel; Escape folds the skill list, then closes the dialog; leaving the view closes it
Work on it types one line (the task's link, the skill, the note) into the Claude panel's session on the thread's AI profile; another profile running or Claude asking something gives a notice instead

Yolo has Claude Code do the task on its own in the background on the thread's profile; the outcome shows above My work (a run stopped by its 20-minute limit says so); the run may change only its own task
Closing a task from Today asks first with an optional comment; the task is done and the comment is in its history
